source.title: WCT Leader Announcement (September 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Carter Thomas has become the new Leader of the WCA Communications (WCT). Carter was already working as a Senior Member of the WCT.

<!-- break -->
Carter was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of September 5, 2026.

We thank Kyle Renatus for the work they have done as the Leader, and wish Carter the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Carter’s application was the only one received. You can view Carter’s candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18MjCLXRTAvCC7U3ixwbJYyBvFUFMFOlb?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 通讯组负责人任命公告（2026 年 9 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Carter Thomas 已成为 WCA 通讯组（WCT）的新任负责人。Carter 此前已是 WCT 的高级成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Carter，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 9 月 5 日生效。

我们感谢 Kyle Renatus 担任负责人期间所做的工作，并祝 Carter 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们只收到了 Carter 的申请。其申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18MjCLXRTAvCC7U3ixwbJYyBvFUFMFOlb?usp=sharing)查看。
